2609.30074.title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
2609.30074.paper_summary: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.
2609.30074.paper_summary_zh: 評估 LLM 系統通常會對小型提示集進行平均並以排名表的形式報告模型。我們詢問這樣的表格值得多少信心，使用基於 LLM 的提示結構推斷作為案例研究：八個開放模型變體，跨越五個家族，參數從 8B 到 675B，快取禁用，持久化 293 個原始中間表示。所測量的現象本身是不穩定的。相同的調用並不可靠地恢復相同的結構，平均節點集 Jaccard 從 0.39 到 0.96，72% 的提示-模型單元從未達到節點集完美。審計評估進一步削弱了其結論，而這是我們的主要貢獻。在提示上進行聯合集群自助法時，只有排名的底部是堅實的：兩個最不具可重複性的模型在 99% 和 86% 的重複中保持排名，中間的四個在 27% 到 48% 之間，前兩個各在 68% 的重複中，因此該表格可靠地識別出最差的模型，但不可靠地識別出最好的模型。兩條同樣合理的合併重複活動的規則改變了八行中的四行，並將整個研究的標題移動了 7 個百分點。檢查推斷的結構與真實標註的對比顯示可重複性不能被解讀為準確性。而且八個端點中的四個在測量後十週內被撤回，因此指定的研究不再能夠進行。因此，小樣本 LLM 評估可能看起來比其證據所支持的更具決定性。我們建議在任何排名旁報告排名穩定性、每個單元的來源、執行的敏感性比較、每次運行的原始輸出以及測量日期。
2609.30074.author: Dipankar Sarkar et.al.
